title: Actuators, Robot Mechanisms and Measurement Systems

questions.q: A pneumatic cylinder has bore 50 mm, supply 6 bar gauge and efficiency 0.9. Find the extend force.
A hydraulic cylinder of 80 mm bore is supplied with 20 L/min. Find the piston speed.
Which actuator family is best for a 50 kN press stroke in a compact space?
questions.explain: Hydraulics have the highest force density.

questions.q: A DC motor (V_a = 24 V, R_a = 1.2 Ω, K_t = K_b = 0.05) drives 0.2 N·m. Find the steady speed in rad/s.
questions.explain: i_a = 4 A, E_b = 19.2 V, ω = 384 rad/s (Example 2.3).

questions.q: Find the mechanical time constant of that motor with J = 2 × 10⁻⁵ kg·m² (in ms).
In a PID position servo with constant load torque, which term removes the steady-state error?
questions.explain: Integral action accumulates error until it is zero.

questions.q: What angle does an RC servo take for a 1.6 ms pulse?
A 3-phase VR stepper has 8 rotor teeth. Find the full-step angle.
A 200-step/rev stepper is pulsed at 1 kHz. Find its speed in rpm.
An 8-pole BLDC motor runs at 3000 rpm. Find the electrical frequency.
A solenoid has N = 1000, I = 0.5 A, A = 1 cm², g = 2 mm. Find the ideal force.
A harmonic drive has 200 flexspline teeth and 202 circular-spline teeth. Find the ratio.
Compared with a serial arm, a parallel (Delta) robot typically has:
questions.explain: Closed chains give stiffness and speed over a small workspace.

questions.q: Find the per-finger gripping force for a 2 kg part, μ = 0.3, a = 5 m/s², two fingers, S = 2.
A shunt must give 50 mV at 100 A. Find its resistance in mΩ.
An in-amp with R = 25 kΩ and R₃/R₂ = 1 must have a gain of 1000. Find R_G in Ω.
Find the cut-off frequency of an RC low-pass with R = 10 kΩ and C = 100 nF.
A cable shield for low-frequency analogue signals should normally be grounded:
questions.explain: Grounding at one end prevents ground-loop current in the shield.
